s: A residential courtyard with a newly planted sapling supported by two bamboo stakes and a soft rope tie; two children in school clothes kneel beside it, one holding a small wooden sign painted with the tree's bark, the other carefully tucking soil around the base with a trowel; a watering can and a spade on the grass; nearby adult residents step around the tree instead of leaning on it. Bright spring morning, friendly warm mood.

A bright school washroom; a dripping faucet with a large shimmering droplet hanging from it, caught mid-fall, ripples in the basin; a small girl in a school uniform reaches out with both hands to turn the tap handle firmly, expression earnest; a bucket of water and a potted plant beside the sink; a poster-free plain wall, clean tiles, daylight from a window.

A cutaway view of a sandy bank: an ant colony's tunnels visible below, the lower chambers already wet with seeping groundwater; above, a column of black ants streams up the slope in a neat line, each carrying a white egg or a seed, antennae alert; a dark cloud bank gathers in the sky behind, and a second, higher nest mound is visible at the top of the bank. Educational cross-section style, earthy palette.

A close-up cutaway of a honeycomb comb face, wax cells hexagonal and golden; a single honeybee stands on the comb doing a figure-eight waggle dance, drawn with faint motion arcs, abdomen wiggling; three other bees stand facing her, antennae forward, watching attentively; in the background a stylised sun and a stylised flower patch hang like a diagram, a dotted line connecting them. Warm amber palette, clear infographic feel, no text.

A budding spring tree branch showing three different bird nests: a cup-shaped nest of twigs and moss, a hanging woven pouch nest, and a round hole nest in a trunk; a small brown bird carries a tuft of grass in its beak toward the cup nest, another tucks a feather into the lining; inside the nest, three pale blue eggs. Fresh green leaves, soft morning light, clear and friendly.

A single milkweed plant divided visually into four stages, arranged on one continuous stem: tiny round eggs on a leaf, a striped caterpillar chewing a leaf edge, a jade-green chrysalis hanging from a twig with golden dots, and an emerged orange monarch butterfly drying its wings; soft motion arcs connect them. Bright meadow background, saturated greens, clear educational composition.

A cross-section illustration of the water cycle: the sea on the left with wavy lines of vapour rising, a bright sun above; the vapour forming a puffy cloud in the middle with visible tiny droplets clustering inside it; rain falling as blue drops over green hills on the right, a small stream running back to the sea with an arrow curving around. Clean diagrammatic scene with a friendly sun, bright palette, no text.

An underwater reef scene: branches of pink and orange coral shown half as branching hard skeleton and half as a living surface covered in tiny flower-like polyps, one enlarged polyp cutaway revealing a small green algae cell nestled inside it, drawn in a soft magnified circle; a tiny clownfish and a sea turtle nearby; clear turquoise water, sunbeams, educational detail.

A summer meadow at night; several fireflies hover above tall grass, each with a soft warm-yellow glowing abdomen, light halos trailing behind them; one enlarged firefly shown in cross-section on the left, its glowing organ highlighted with a soft round glow and tiny bubbles of air, drawn as a magnified inset; a child crouches admiring from a distance without touching. Deep blue-green night, warm gold accents, gentle wonder.

The sun at the centre with a large tilted globe on an elliptical orbit shown as a dotted ring; four positions of the globe are labelled by scene instead of text: snowy trees, blooming flowers, bright wheat, falling orange leaves; one side of the globe is bathed in golden sunlight, the other in shadow; small arrows show rotation and orbit. Clean cosmic illustration, deep blue with warm sun, clear geometry.

A child's wooden table with a simple experiment laid out: an arch-shaped red and blue horseshoe magnet held by a small hand, paper clips and iron nails leaping toward its poles in mid-air, a wooden block and an eraser and a plastic toy sitting unmoved nearby; a sheet of paper with clips beneath it, the magnet above, an arrow showing the clips sliding along. Bright natural light, playful scientific mood.

A pond scene in a single arc: a cluster of jelly-like frog eggs on a reed, a black tadpole with a long tail, a larger tadpole with tiny hind legs, then front legs and a shortening tail, then a small green frog sitting on a lily pad; dotted motion arcs connect the stages; lily pads, dragonflies, clear shallow water. Bright greens, friendly educational composition.

A cutaway of a grassy mound: a large underground ant nest shown in cross-section with branching tunnels and round chambers, one chamber full of white eggs and larvae tended by worker ants, one chamber storing seeds, one with a larger queen ant surrounded by attendants; above ground, a small hole entrance with a guarded ant, and a second ant carrying a crumb. Sunny meadow, earthy palette, clear structure.

A split scene: on the left a bee hovers at a flower, its long tubular tongue dipping into the bloom, pollen dusting its legs, a dotted line showing nectar flowing into its abdomen; on the right a cutaway of a honeycomb with bees fanning their wings over open cells, water vapour lines rising, golden honey glistening in the cells. Warm amber and green palette, clear cause-and-effect composition.

A diagrammatic cosmic scene: a large tilted globe on an orbit around the sun, shown at two positions; at the summer position the upper hemisphere faces the sun with bright golden rays, at the winter position the rays strike at a slant and the hemisphere is shadowed blue; in between, small seasonal vignettes of blossom, wheat, and snow. Clean dark blue space, luminous sun, crisp geometry, no text.

A cutaway of a small drum with visible vibration arcs around the drumhead; concentric expanding rings travel through the air toward a child's ear on the right, drawn as layered pale blue curves, and below them a wooden table offers a second path with denser, faster-travelling rings; a hand taps the drum. Cutaway detail, clean educational style, warm wood tones with cool blue waves.

Two bar magnets facing each other, one held in each of two children's hands: the red north poles push apart with visible repulsion arcs and small arrows, while the blue and red ends of a second pair snap together; between them a paper clip chain hangs suspended from one magnet; a scattered pile of clips, nails, wood and plastic nearby. Bright tabletop light, clear demonstration.

A large blue earth with the moon on a dotted circular orbit around it, shown at four positions; sunlight comes from the right as broad golden rays; each moon position shows the lit half facing the sun, and a small inset moon below shows what an observer on earth would see: full, half, crescent, new. Dark space with stars, clean diagram composition, no text.

A cross-section of dark soil with a small seed split open and a pale green shoot pushing upward, one root already reaching down; the shoot is shown bending slightly and then breaking through the soil surface with a tiny crack and crumb of earth lifting; above ground a sprout with two seed leaves unfolds toward a warm sun and raindrops. Rich brown soil, fresh green, hopeful light.

A clearing sky after rain; a wide arc of seven clean colour bands from red on the outside to violet on the inside, arching over green hills; in the foreground a large water droplet floats magnified, with a beam of white sunlight entering one side and fanning into a rainbow spectrum out the other side; small droplets float in the air. Bright joyful palette, clear scientific inset.

A meadow after rain; a rainbow arching over a soft grey cloud; in the foreground a single large dewdrop on a blade of grass is drawn as a magnified inset: a white light beam enters, bends, and splits into seven colour bands spreading out; smaller droplets around it each show a faint rainbow glint. Fresh green and rainbow colours, dew highlights, gentle educational mood.

A friendly cartoon cross-section of a tooth: white enamel on the outside, dentine beneath, a pink pulp centre with tiny nerves; on the tooth's surface a small patch is under attack by three round purple bacteria with tiny mischievous faces, releasing acid droplets that etch a little hole; a toothbrush with foamy bubbles arrives from the left. Clean bright illustration, playful but clear.

A cutaway of a flower pot: a seed in dark soil sending down one pale root and pushing up a curved green shoot; above the soil, a watering can tips out drops, and a warm sun shines through the window; next to the pot a slightly older seedling with two leaves, and a proud little girl in an apron holds the pot with both hands. Warm windowsill light, fresh green, clear growth stages.

A sunny playground; a child stands with arms out, casting a long dark shadow on the paving; the sun low on the left is drawn with straight rays, and a diagram-style dotted line shows the light being blocked by the child's body to create the shadow; a second smaller shadow shape beside it shows the same child at noon with a shorter shadow. Bright clean daylight, clear educational visual.

A clear glass basin of water on a wooden table; a stone and an eraser rest at the bottom with small bubbles, while a wooden block, a leaf and a ping-pong ball float on the surface; a child's hand hovers above, about to drop in one more object; small arrows show the downward and upward forces as simple arcs. Bright window light, water reflections, neat experiment mood.

A friendly cutaway of a child's nose and face in profile: inside the nasal passage fine hairs and a pink moist lining are visible, catching small grey dust specks and pollen grains; a burst of air arrows rushes outward from the nostril carrying the specks away; the child holds a tissue near the face. Clean bright illustration, soft skin tones, clear cause and effect.

A child's red mitten held out in falling snow; on the mitten a large snowflake sits, magnified in an inset circle beside it to show its perfect six-fold branching symmetry; around them other snowflakes of different six-armed shapes drift down; behind, a soft blue winter street. Cool blue-white palette, delicate detail, quiet wonder.

A bright sun on the left radiating golden light toward a blue-green earth on the right, with a dotted orbit line curving around; on earth a small figure stands on the daylit side with the sun overhead, while the far side is in night with tiny stars; an arrow shows the earth's spin. Clean cosmic illustration, warm sun, deep blue space, clear scale.

A field of tall sunflowers with big round faces all turned toward a bright sun; one sunflower shown enlarged in cross-section: its stem is longer on the shaded side and shorter on the sunlit side, drawn with clear arrows, which tips the head toward the sun; a dotted arc shows the head's daily movement from east to west. Golden afternoon light, warm cheerful palette.

Three side-by-side panels in one scene: a glass of liquid water with clear blue surface, a block of ice with crystalline facets and frost, and a kettle puffing white steam that thins into invisible vapour; small arrows between them show heating and cooling, with a sun over the melting ice and a flame-like warm glow under the kettle. Clear, bright, diagrammatic but friendly.

A cheerful bathroom scene: a small boy in pyjamas holds a toothbrush, one hand on his cheek with a pained wince; beside him a magnified inset of a tooth surface where little purple bacteria are feeding on a sugar crystal and producing a shiny acid drop that etches a small cavity; a plate with a half-eaten candy sits on the sink. Warm bathroom light, playful educational tone.

A cut tree stump seen from above, its rings varied in width, with a forester's hand holding a magnifier over one section; on the left a diagram-like inset shows a wide ring paired with a sun and raindrops, and a narrow dark ring paired with a cracked dry sun; scattered sawdust and an axe on the ground. Warm wood tones, clear educational detail.

A looping journey illustrated in one scene: a smiling droplet in the blue sea on the left, warm sun rays making wavy lines of vapour rise, a white cloud in the middle with droplets clustering inside, rain falling over green hills on the right, a stream running back toward the sea with a curved arrow completing the loop; a rainbow glints. Bright cheerful palette, clear cycle.

A puffy white cloud drawn as a soft shape with a cutaway section revealing many tiny round water droplets and small ice crystals clustered together; below, warm sun rays over a lake send wavy vapour lines upward into the cloud; on the right the cloud grows heavy and darker, with a few drops beginning to fall. Soft blue sky, friendly diagram style, clear cause and effect.

A layered earth cross-section: on the surface a green prehistoric landscape with a few friendly cartoon dinosaurs and ferns, and above them a changing sky; in the sediment layers below, a dinosaur skeleton fossil is partially exposed, with a paleontologist's brush and trowel carefully clearing the rock around a rib bone. Warm ochre and green palette, clear educational framing.

A sunlit garden; a child stands casting a shadow behind them, and the scene is drawn as a clear geometric diagram: straight rays from the sun pass the child's body and are blocked, leaving a dark shape on the ground; beside it a small inset shows the same child at different sun angles with short and long shadows; a hand making a shadow puppet of a rabbit on a wall. Bright clean light.

A cross-section of a coastal landscape: over warm land the air is drawn rising with curly arrows, while over the cooler sea cooler air sinks and slides inland to replace it; a windmill on the hill turns, a small sailboat leans, leaves and a kite stream sideways; a sun over the land and a blue sea with a few clouds. Fresh blue-green palette, clear airflow arrows.

A bird in gliding flight shown in cutaway: hollow bone structure visible inside one wing, broad feathered wings spread, flight feathers painted with clean detail; airflow lines curve over the wing's top surface and under the bottom, with a small upward lift arrow; near the tail a few contour feathers fan out; below, a distant small airplane echoes the wing shape. Clean sky background, clear aerodynamic diagram.

A single maple tree half green and half in autumn colour; on the green side an enlarged leaf inset shows round green chlorophyll shapes absorbing sunlight; on the gold-red side the same inset shows the green shapes fading away to reveal yellow and orange pigments beneath; fallen leaves drift down. Warm autumn palette, crisp educational comparison.

A night sky with stars above, and a cutaway of the earth's atmosphere drawn as wavy layered bands; a star's light beam enters from the top and bends and wiggles as it passes through moving air layers, drawn with a slightly fractured, shimmering line; below, a child on a hill looks up, and the star appears to flicker. Deep blue night, warm yellow star, soft magical-but-clear style.

A diagrammatic night scene: the sun off to the right shining on a large earth, the moon at four points on its orbit, and four small moon discs along the bottom showing the crescent, half, full and new shapes as seen from earth; a spotlight-like cone of light illustrates which half of the moon is lit; stars and a soft dark blue background. Clean, clear, no text.

A dramatic but friendly thundercloud shown in cutaway, with bright zigzag lightning bolts leaping from the cloud base to the ground and small glowing spark-like charge marks floating inside the cloud; concentric sound wave arcs radiate from the lightning path; below, a child watches safely from a window with a warm-lit room; a distant tree bends in wind. Deep purple-blue storm sky, bright white-blue bolts, no text.

A cheerful close-up of a child's face mid-sneeze, eyes squeezed shut, mouth open, one hand raising a tissue; beside the face a magnified cutaway shows the nasal passage with fine hairs trapping grey dust and yellow pollen grains, and a strong curved arrow of air rushing out; small sparkle-like specks fly away. Bright, friendly, clean illustration, clear cause and effect.
